_comment: `consumer.js` is an entry without side effects, and `c.js` and `logger.js` import it only for a binding that tree shaking removes. Such an entry is in `load_dependencies` only to place the chunks, so `predicted_static_import_targets` follows the removed imports, and a dominator search on those edges merges the runtime into the chunk of `consumer.js`. The kept-import rule counts such an entry only when the importer uses one of its bindings.
